lines: You can make perfect notes, and still remember none of it.
Copying feels like studying. But the words go from the page, to your pen, to the page.
Your brain copied them. It never had to use them. So they fade.
Pulling the answer out yourself is what makes it stick.
That's why every Unspool reel explains it simply, then quizzes you.
